metadata.title: SGA 1, SGA 2, SGA 5, and SGA 6: Modern LaTeX Working Editions, Bounded Translations, and Audit Materials
metadata.version: 2026-07-19 direct PDF and TeX companions for all current SGA readers
metadata.description:
This record contains machine-assisted modern-LaTeX working editions, bounded translations, source workpasses, and audit materials for SGA 1, SGA 2, SGA 5, and SGA 6.

Direct downloads: all eight current reader-facing PDFs now have directly downloadable TeX companions. The record remains well below Zenodo's file-count limit, so editable sources are not needlessly hidden inside evidence ZIPs. Modular evidence archives remain available for ledgers, build receipts, validation, and render QA.

SGA 1: the bounded English checkpoint covers Expose I opening through section I.6, French authority lines 556-1216, and continues at line 1217, section I.7.

SGA 2: the bounded English checkpoints contain complete Exposes V and VI. Expose V covers corrected French lines 1770-2136. Expose VI covers lines 2139-2272 and continues at line 2274, Expose VII. SGA 1 and SGA 2 are active translation lanes; neither volume is complete.

SGA 5: the French workpass and selected ten-expose English source-synchronized working edition each have direct TeX. SGA 5 is not complete.

SGA 6: direct TeX accompanies the French idx684 source-rescribe workpass, the 377-page English layered reader, and the bounded Spanish Expose X idx532-537 tranche. The English direct source is mechanically flattened from the exact dependency-closed modular source and rebuilds to byte-identical extracted text. Authority remains non-uniform outside promoted source-reviewed layers.

Verification: fresh two-pass builds of the five newly exposed SGA 5/6 TeX files reproduced public page counts of 306, 309, 374, 377, and 4 pages with byte-identical UTF-8 layout-text extraction and zero fatal diagnostics. Existing layout warnings in unchanged SGA 5 workpass sources remain part of their working status.

Status and rights: these are working translations, source workpasses, and audit materials, not critical editions, peer review, proof certification, independent human review, accessibility certification, native/community certification, complete SGA volumes, or rights-clearance determinations. No blanket license over French sources or new translations is asserted. Rights remain License Not Specified.

GitHub: corrections and improvements can be proposed at https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.

additional_descriptions.description: Eight reader PDFs have eight direct TeX companions. SGA 1 continues at I.7; SGA 2 continues at Expose VII. SGA 5 is a selected working edition, not a complete volume. SGA 6 remains a mixed-authority layered reader rather than a uniform source-faithful edition. Public visual packages contain 37 project-generated renders and no French-source pixels. No critical-edition, independent-human-review, completion, certification, accessibility, or rights-clearance claim is made.

access_status.description_l10n: The record and files are publicly accessible.
